U.note: Elegant tall classic lamp with rocket cap, glowing pool and soft merging wax, minimal controls below; wax is a bit murky and low contrast.

V.note: Convincing classic lamp with purple liquid, glowing hot wax that stretches and splits, chrome base with indicator and floor glow, tidy control bar.

W.note: Brass lamp with discrete flat pink blobs that merge a bit, but the glass is dark and flat, the wax is sparse and the panel dominates.

X.note: Good rosy glass and copper base, but the wax is mostly one lumpy mass with a single orbiting ball, so the motion is less organic.

Y.note: Wax reads as a big flat orange mass filling the lower glass and the tiny cap is odd; switching off blacks out the whole lamp, breaking the illusion.

Z.note: Pretty bulbous glass with highlights and warm ambient glow and believable column of wax, though the shape is less iconic and the wax is monotone.
